name: Juroku Financial Group Inc
summary: Juroku Financial Group, Inc. operates as a comprehensive banking institution in Japan, delivering a diverse range of financial solutions. Its fundamental offerings include various deposit accounts, such as checking, savings, time, and foreign currency deposits, in addition to certificates of deposit. The group provides extensive credit facilities, offering bill loans, overdrafts, and discounting services for commercial, exchange, and bank underwriting bills, alongside electronic recorded receivables and commodity securities trading. Beyond core banking, Juroku Financial Group actively invests in government, municipal, and corporate bonds, as well as corporate stocks. It facilitates international financial dealings through remittance and foreign exchange services, covering import, export, and other forex transactions. The company also engages in derivative trading, including interest rate swaps, coupon swaps, and currency options. Its agency functions involve managing public funds, processing stock payments and dividends, and handling principal and interest payments for public and corporate bonds. Furthermore, it operates as a loan and trust agent, provides financial product brokerage, offers debt guarantees, and underwrites public bonds. Over-the-counter sales include public bonds, insurance policies, and investment trusts. Supplemental services encompass credit cards, computer solutions, and credit guarantee provision. Established in Gifu, Japan, in 1877, Juroku Financial Group boasts a substantial operational network. This infrastructure consists of 149 branches, 12 smaller branch offices, 16 dedicated loan centers, 1 ancillary business handling office, 4 international representative offices, and 239 automated teller machines (ATMs).
